final_message:
**Status:** Reproduced

**Expected:** `<template #_duration>` content is rendered in `SubComponent`, as in Vue 3.5.13, in place of the `<slot name="_duration">` fallback.

**Actual:** The fallback content ("default _duration") is rendered. The `#title` template next to it works.

**Trigger:** A component (`SubComponent`) with `#_name` slot templates sits in the default slot of another component (`BaseLayout`). That component also gets a conditional named slot (`<template v-if="cond" #randomslotname>`). Without the `v-if` sibling it works. It fails with runtime-compiled templates and with SFC-style compilation (`prefixIdentifiers: true`). The same scenario passes on published `vue@3.5.13` and fails on `vue@3.5.14` and on this checkout.

**Run:** `pnpm vitest run --project unit packages/vue/__tests__/underscoreSlotName.spec.ts` (exits 1 now; 2 of 3 tests fail, and the no-`v-if` control passes)

**Passes when:** Setting the `assignSlots` condition in `packages/runtime-core/src/componentSlots.ts` back to `optimized || key !== '_'` makes all 3 tests pass. I reverted that edit afterwards. Published `vue@3.5.13` also renders `_duration works` for the same scenario.

**Artifacts:** The check is `packages/vue/__tests__/underscoreSlotName.spec.ts`, the only change in the working tree. No production code was changed.

Likely cause: `assignSlots` in `packages/runtime-core/src/componentSlots.ts` now filters slot keys with `!isInternalKey(key)`, which drops every key starting with `_`. Before, it only skipped the `_` flag itself. The `v-if` slot makes the parent's slot Fragment BAIL, so the child mounts unoptimized and loses `_duration`.
